laws.typed_planes: relation family plane law direction units transport and source class remain explicit and participate in operator identity; scalar pairwise affinity cannot reconstruct the operator
laws.nary: container role ordinal and constituent identities remain field metadata and cannot be replaced by anonymous pairwise endpoints
laws.evidence: precision is nonnegative and keyed to eligible dependence roots; copied descendants cannot increase precision without a separately admitted independent root
laws.contradiction: competing targets remain separate typed constraints with positive precision; contradiction never becomes negative precision
laws.matrix_free: direct application and a materialized dense operator generated from the same pinned contract must agree within the declared numeric tolerance
laws.scope: only relation families and source classes selected by the program enter the generated operator; no universal adjacency graph is persisted as semantic authority
